tips.text: Tranq the fox first, then bring Infested to the sleeping fox; a sleeping one still counts as Weakened and cannot flee.
Go invisible or pull aggro off yourself, or the Infested attack you and ignore the fox.
Skip the targeted hunt; Sly is the common breed and turns up while you mine or run bounties.
Mind Control an enemy near the trail, tranq the fox, then release the control so the enemy attacks the fox.
Drag a small flying Infested such as an Osprey over the sleeping fox; Juggernauts and bosses kill it outright.
Tranq the fox, then use Nidus Larva to pull it into enemies.
Pick an Antigen whose first polarity matches your build; it works as a free Forma slot.
Expect the Sly itself to be easy but the Weakened capture step to be fiddly.
Treat Sly as a cheap, fast Mastery pickup once gilded; most players prefer Panzer for actual use.
